architecture_contract.warning: The Nature paper describes 200 accessible regions, while the pinned released YAML requests 900. The exact checkpoint-bound configuration is unresolved and must be read from an admitted checkpoint rather than inferred from either value.

input_contract.accessibility_feature: one observed accessibility value per selected region
input_contract.binary_atac_mode: Setting accessibility values to one still requires an observed cell-context accessible-region universe; it is not a sequence-only mode.
input_contract.canonical_tensor: region_by_283_features: 282 motif-cluster features plus observed accessibility
input_contract.donor_or_cell_context: supplied through the observed accessible-region set and accessibility feature
input_contract.motif_features: sequence-derived motif-cluster values for each observed accessible region
input_contract.region_span: published examples select 200 accessible regions spanning approximately 2_to_4_Mb
input_contract.sealed_input_interpretation: GSE289173 provides DNA and single-nucleus RNA but no ATAC. It cannot produce a native GET input without an external RNA-to-ATAC proxy, which would be a different model.

native_checkpoint.storage_access_observation: On 2026-08-22 the official bucket rejected anonymous listing and object requests because it is Requester Pays. No weight bytes were acquired.
native_checkpoint.warning: The registered S3 prefix is mutable and is not a checkpoint identity. No GET run is admissible until one exact object, version or equivalent immutable identity, size, hash, configuration, and task head are frozen.

output_contract.expression_head: two nonnegative expression outputs representing positive and negative strand targets
output_contract.fine_tuning_objective: Poisson negative log likelihood for expression
output_contract.native_pretraining_output: masked or held-region regulatory representation objectives rather than a sealed signed eQTL effect
output_contract.signed_variant_effect: Not a native raw-DNA output. A candidate ALT-minus-REF effect can only be constructed by changing motif features inside a prespecified observed accessible peak while holding the development-derived context fixed.
output_contract.task_semantics_warning: The pretraining checkpoint requires a task head; the fetal/adult fine-tuned checkpoint is an expression model. They cannot be substituted without separate manifests and parity checks.

reference_contract.reference_gate: Freeze the v40-to-v49 gene and TSS crosswalk, motif database and clustering artifact, peak coordinate convention, contig mapping, REF checks, and any sequence window extraction before use.

runtime_contract.storage_runtime_warning: The official demo uses anonymous s3fs, but the bucket now requires authenticated Requester Pays access. Runtime network retrieval is forbidden.

safe_loading_contract.official_loader_risk: get_model.utils.load_checkpoint invokes torch.load with weights_only=False. A .pth object is executable pickle-backed content and must not be opened in the campaign environment.
safe_loading_contract.required_path: After explicit acquisition approval, download the exact immutable object into an isolated no-network environment, verify external object metadata and hash, inspect and convert only recognized tensors, freeze every tensor name, shape, and dtype, then strict-load a tensor-only artifact.
safe_loading_contract.runtime_network_policy: No runtime network or S3 access.

source_evidence: The Nature paper, pinned official GET repository, pinned official demo, and official S3 responses were checked on 2026-08-22. No checkpoint bytes were downloaded or deserialized.

terms_audit.warning: A package metadata declaration is not a substitute for a complete license grant tied to code and weights.
